column1: # The function token (the domain token contract, «Проверка»): token(keys, revoked, now, token) → ok payload | refused <слово>.
# input — the input of the command token as JSON text: keys — the accepted document of the set (the domain key set contract «Набор»);
# revoked — the row domain/revoked as read or null (there is no row); now — the checker's wall-clock seconds; token — as it came;
# expect? — {kind, cluster: <член> | null, audience_claim?} of the recipient. expect — a subset of the output {result, payload?, reason?}.
# The rows — the acceptance inputs of М11/2 inputs/token-*.json, sc. 04–07, 12, without a change of bytes (the spaces outside JSON strings removed).
# token-30, token-31, token-32 — the input token-18 with expect out of form (without the key cluster; cluster: null with kind ≠ person; an unknown key): the expectation
# @exit 2 — the exit code of the command is 2, the output is not compared (analysis of the review of stage B 8–10, № 13).
